class.name: AdapterListUpdateCallback
class.brief_description: Forwards list-update events to an Adapter's notify calls.
class.description: AdapterListUpdateCallback bridges the [b]ListUpdateCallback[/b] protocol to an [b]Adapter[/b]: [method set_adapter] picks the adapter and the [code]_on_*[/code] events become the matching [code]Adapter.notify_item_*[/code] calls. This is what [method ListAdapter.submit_list] uses internally to drive a RecyclerView.

method.name: set_adapter
method.description: Sets the [b]Adapter[/b] that receives the forwarded notify calls.
